milestones.title: Verify component c01 at grouping level 1
Verify component c02 at grouping level 1

S1.instruction: Process current c01 source records in given order. Strip whitespace from every value; uppercase record_id and client, and lowercase kind and status. Retain only records with status ok, nonempty normalized record_id and client, kind sale or refund, quantity matching ASCII [0-9]{1,2} and integer 1..50, and unit_price matching ASCII [0-9]{1,5}.[0-9]{2} with a literal decimal point. Skip invalid records before deduplicating; retain only the first valid record per normalized record_id. Convert unit_price exactly to integer cents; compute quantity times unit_cents, negative for refunds and positive for sales. Preserve kind and quantity, then sort retained rows lexically by record_id and produce the prescribed row shape. Recompute against the latest environment.

S2.instruction: Using the current c01_rows output, group retained rows by normalized client in lexical order. For each client, set count to the number of retained records and net_cents to the sum of their signed integer net_cents. Use exact integer arithmetic and produce the prescribed aggregate shape; recompute if the current environment changes.

S3.instruction: Using the current c01_aggregates, render the report with no trailing newline: first line CLIENT COUNT NET; then one line per client in lexical order as <client> <count> <net amount with exactly two decimal places>; final line TOTAL <retained record count> <grand net amount with exactly two decimal places>. Format amounts from integer cents, use single spaces, and include a negative sign only for negative amounts. Recompute if the environment changes.

S4.instruction: Check that c01_report passes and that it is the current report for component c01. Then provide the certification artifact with environment_revision equal to c01's current component revision and checked_gates exactly ["c01_report"]. Do not certify unless the referenced gate actually passes.

S5.instruction: Reprocess c02 from the current source records in given order. Strip whitespace from every value; uppercase record_id and client, and lowercase kind and status. Reject invalid records before deduplication. Keep only status ok, nonempty normalized record_id and client, kind sale or refund, quantity matching ASCII [0-9]{1,2} and in 1..50, and unit_price matching ASCII [0-9]{1,5}.[0-9]{2} with a literal decimal point. Retain only the first valid record per normalized record_id. Convert unit_price to integer cents directly from its decimal digits, without floating-point arithmetic; multiply quantity by unit_cents exactly, negating only refunds. Preserve kind and quantity, sort rows lexically by record_id, and produce the prescribed row shape. Recompute against the latest environment.

S6.instruction: Using the current c02_rows output, group retained rows by normalized client in lexical order. For each client, set count to the number of retained records and net_cents to the sum of their signed integer net_cents. Use exact integer arithmetic and produce the prescribed aggregate shape; recompute if the current environment changes.

S7.instruction: Using the current c02_aggregates, render the report with no trailing newline: first line CLIENT COUNT NET; then one line per client in lexical order as <client> <count> <net amount with exactly two decimal places>; final line TOTAL <retained record count> <grand net amount with exactly two decimal places>. Format amounts from integer cents, use single spaces, and include a negative sign only for negative amounts. Recompute if the environment changes.

S8.instruction: Check that c02_report passes and that it is the current report for component c02. Then provide the certification artifact with environment_revision equal to c02's current component revision and checked_gates exactly ["c02_report"]. Do not certify unless the referenced gate actually passes.
